Welcome to Business and Finance

Featured News

Administration and Resources

Managing ASU's financial and business operations

The Office of the Executive Vice President, Treasurer and Chief Financial Officer supports the New American University's vision of excellence, access and impact by effectively leading and managing its financial and business operations and developing ASU's human and capital resources.

Vision Statement

Business and Finance will be a preeminent provider of critical services and functions to the ASU community, offering timely, cost-effective, high-quality support to a wide range of stakeholders throughout the university's four campuses, the State of Arizona and beyond.
